pick.name: Self-file on IP India (classes 9 + 42)
pick.what: Online TM-A filing at the Indian Trade Marks Registry
pick.why: Rs 4,500 per class for individuals/startups/small enterprises (Rs 9,000 others); class 9 (software/apps) + 42 (SaaS) covers the product; India filing is the base for Madrid
pick.free_limits: TM-A e-filing Rs 4,500 per class per mark (individual/startup/small enterprise), Rs 9,000 others; expedited exam Rs 20,000 (individual/startup/small) or Rs 40,000 per class, e-filing only

alts.name: WIPO Madrid System (via IP India)
alts.what: One international application designating many countries
alts.why: Cheapest way to extend to US/EU/UK later: base fee CHF 653 (CHF 903 colour) + per-country fees; needs the Indian application as the base
alts.free_limits: No free tier; use the fee calculator

alts.name: Trademark agent/attorney filing
alts.what: Paid attorney handles search, filing, objections
alts.why: Worth it if the examiner objects or opposition is filed
alts.free_limits: Professional fees on top of govt fees (unverified)

candidates.name: Self-file on IP India
candidates.verdict: PICK: lowest cost; Claude can draft the goods/services spec

candidates.name: Madrid Protocol
candidates.verdict: Add once you have US/EU revenue (base CHF 653 + designations)

candidates.name: Direct USPTO filing
candidates.verdict: Only if you need US-only fast; fees not verified

candidates.name: Agent filing (Vakilsearch, law firms)
candidates.verdict: Use for objections/oppositions, not for the first filing

candidates.name: Class 35/41
candidates.verdict: Add 35 only for services/consulting branding; skip otherwise

decision: File the word mark yourself on IP India in classes 9 and 42 at the reduced rate (Udyam makes a company a small enterprise). Search the IP India public search and the WIPO Global Brand Database first. Go to Madrid when a foreign market matters.
details: India's Madrid membership (since 2013) is from memory and was not confirmed on the page fetched (unverified).
